import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(breed_counts))
breed_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()
age_data = age_data[age_data <= 25]  # Filter outliers
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=25, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.axvline(age_data.median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {age_data.median():.1f} years')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='orange', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.9, len(district_counts)))
district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Owner Age vs Dog Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation
owner_age_dog_sex = pd.crosstab(df['AlterV10Lang'], df['SexHundLang'], normalize='index') * 100
# Filter out unknown/rare categories and reorder
valid_ages = ['20- bis 29-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige', '40- bis 49-Jährige', 
              '50- bis 59-Jährige', '60- bis 69-Jährige', '70- bis 79-Jährige']
owner_age_dog_sex_filtered = owner_age_dog_sex.reindex([age for age in valid_ages if age in owner_age_dog_sex.index])

if 'männlich' in owner_age_dog_sex_filtered.columns and 'weiblich' in owner_age_dog_sex_filtered.columns:
    x = np.arange(len(owner_age_dog_sex_filtered))
    width = 0.35
    ax4.bar(x - width/2, owner_age_dog_sex_filtered['männlich'], width, 
            label='Male Dogs', color='#3498db', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
    ax4.bar(x + width/2, owner_age_dog_sex_filtered['weiblich'], width, 
            label='Female Dogs', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
    ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
    ax4.set_xticks(x)
    ax4.set_xticklabels([label.replace('-Jährige', '').replace('- bis ', '-') 
                         for label in owner_age_dog_sex_filtered.index], rotation=45, ha='right')
    ax4.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, shadow=True)
    ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
